title: Finite-coin cubic sampling with shared Mersenne fingerprint

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 inversion instance, the complete algorithm returns an encoded G2 point Q with pairing(Q,P)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with probability >0.39024, conditional on the explicit bounded fair-coin interface and finite storage-controller admissibility. Complete cold classical work including table construction, all failures, hashes, native arithmetic, transfers, sorting, reconstruction and verification is <=2^(12609/100) reference equivalents with unchanged C=20000. Peak memory <2^137 bytes, cold preprocessing <2^120 scalar instructions included in total, advice0 bytes. The explicit finite first/second moment argument does not presume independent collisions or a Poisson law. No production execution or qualification is asserted.
